I am upgrading the artifact severity slightly to account for the high probability of anatomical hallucination in the occluded limb regions, indicated by the pose auditor's failure to lock onto standard avian/mammalian joint structures (note: ViTPose is mammal-centric, so bird leg mapping is inherently noisy, but the total collapse of confidence suggests the AI generation lacks clear limb definition even for a generic detector).
